name: VSB Power Line Fault Detection 1st Place — Signal Processing + Hybrid Model Blend
summary: Binary fault detection from high-frequency power line signals using wavelet denoising, peak detection feature engineering, and a weighted blend of LightGBM on handcrafted features with 1D CNN+LSTM on raw denoised signals.
dejargonized_summary: Detect electrical faults in power lines by cleaning up noisy voltage signals, finding discharge spikes, and combining a tree-based model on spike statistics with a neural network on the cleaned raw signal.

inputs.name: voltage_signal
inputs.constraints: Shape (800000,). High-frequency power line voltage signal per measurement.

planning_constraints.subject: denoising_first
planning_constraints.statement: Wavelet denoising must precede peak detection and feature extraction.
planning_constraints.rationale: High-voltage base noise creates false peaks; denoising removes the noise floor so that corona discharge events can be reliably detected.

planning_constraints.subject: hybrid_complementarity
planning_constraints.statement: Both LightGBM on handcrafted features and CNN+LSTM on raw signal should be trained independently and blended.
planning_constraints.rationale: Handcrafted peak features capture domain knowledge while the neural network discovers patterns not captured by manual feature engineering.

stages.name: Wavelet Denoising
stages.description: Apply discrete wavelet transform (DWT) using PyWavelets to filter out high-voltage base noise from the raw power line signal. Threshold wavelet coefficients to remove noise while preserving corona discharge events.
stages.dejargonized_description: Clean up the noisy voltage signal by decomposing it into frequency layers and removing the noise, keeping only the meaningful discharge patterns.
preconditions: Input is a 1D high-frequency voltage signal.
guarantees: Output preserves corona discharge events while suppressing base noise.
family_notes: DWT is preferred over FFT-based denoising because discharge events are transient and localized in time.

stages.name: Peak Detection
stages.description: Locate corona discharge peaks in the denoised signal using scipy.signal.find_peaks with tuned height and distance parameters.
stages.dejargonized_description: Find the sharp spikes in the cleaned signal that indicate electrical discharge events.

outputs.name: peak_properties
outputs.constraints: Peak heights, widths, prominences from find_peaks.

guarantees: Detected peaks correspond to putative discharge events.

stages.name: Peak Feature Extraction
stages.description: Compute statistical features from detected peaks (height, width, count) plus raw statistical moments (mean, std, skewness, kurtosis) of the denoised signal.
stages.dejargonized_description: Calculate summary statistics about the spikes (how tall, how wide, how many) and overall signal properties to describe each measurement as a set of numbers.

outputs.name: peak_features
outputs.constraints: Shape (F,). Feature vector summarizing peaks and signal statistics.

preconditions: Peaks have been detected and their properties computed.
guarantees: Feature vector captures domain-relevant signal characteristics.

stages.name: Signal to Matrix Transform
stages.description: Slice the 1D high-frequency signal into a 2D matrix (spectrogram-like) by reshaping into fixed-width segments, creating a representation suitable for 2D pattern recognition.
stages.dejargonized_description: Chop the long signal into equal-length segments and stack them as rows to create a 2D image-like representation.

outputs.name: signal_matrix
outputs.constraints: Shape (R, C). 2D representation of the 1D signal.

preconditions: Signal length is divisible by segment width or is padded.
guarantees: Output is a 2D matrix preserving temporal structure in rows.
family_notes: This spectrogram-like transform enables detection of periodic discharge patterns across power cycles.

stages.name: Tabular Model
stages.description: Train a LightGBM classifier on the extracted peak features and statistical moments for binary fault classification.
stages.dejargonized_description: Train a tree-based model on the hand-designed spike statistics to predict whether a fault is present.

inputs.name: peak_features
inputs.constraints: Shape (N, F). Feature matrix for all measurements.

preconditions: Peak features are computed for all samples.
guarantees: Output probabilities reflect fault likelihood based on handcrafted features.

stages.name: Deep Learning Model
stages.description: Train a 1D CNN + LSTM network on the raw denoised signal for binary fault classification. The CNN extracts local patterns while the LSTM captures temporal dependencies.
stages.dejargonized_description: Train a neural network that reads the cleaned signal directly, using convolutional layers to find local patterns and recurrent layers to understand long-range structure.

inputs.name: denoised_signal
inputs.constraints: Shape (N, 800000). Denoised signals for all measurements.

guarantees: Output probabilities capture patterns beyond handcrafted features.
family_notes: The 1D CNN + LSTM architecture can discover discharge patterns not captured by peak detection.

stages.name: Weighted Blend
stages.description: Compute a weighted average of LightGBM and neural network fault probabilities to produce the final prediction.
stages.dejargonized_description: Combine the tree model and neural network predictions using a weighted average for a more reliable final answer.
guarantees: Output is a weighted combination of both models.

audit.rationale: 1st place VSB Power Line Fault Detection solution. Hybrid approach combining wavelet-denoised peak feature engineering with end-to-end deep learning on raw signals.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Detect power line faults by cleaning noisy voltage signals, finding discharge spikes, and combining a tree model on spike statistics with a neural network on the raw cleaned signal.
provenance_notes: Source: Kaggle VSB Power Line Fault Detection 1st place solution (2019)
uncertainty_notes: Wavelet denoising parameters are tuned to the specific noise characteristics of the competition data.
The weighted blend ratio between LightGBM and CNN+LSTM may not generalize to other signal types.
